item: Row B3 the config rewrite: every shipped catalogue speaks alpha-3, the loaders and the tools that write the files follow
key_paths: scripts/rewrite_config_countries.py; configs/*.yml; src/catalog/countries.py; src/law/catalog.py; src/catalog/cities.py; src/timemap/anchors.py; src/events/catalog.py; src/events/feeds.py; src/discovery/channels.py; src/catalog/build.py; scripts/merge_source_batch.py; scripts/validate_legal_catalog.py; tests/test_config_country_rewrite.py
summary: S05-02 S3, Q305. One scripted text pass rewrote 5,699 country/jurisdiction values in 12 configs to uppercase alpha-3 (5,682 lines, 0 unplaced), proving by parse that only country values differ; loaders that only lowercased the value and the law catalogue read either spelling (config_country; the law jurisdiction lands on the stored uk/eu/int so seeding makes no second row); an old-tree vs new-tree dump of every loader and the seeded rows is identical except the Norges Bank event, whose unquoted NO was YAML's false and is now NOR; batch merge, enrichment merge, tag cleanup and the world-catalogue writer emit alpha-3, the legal validator reads both; a repo test (mutation-checked) pins that none is left. Row B stays OPEN: B4.
